historical_diagnostic_use.source: W5 Error Analysis and representative W4/W5 Query Relevance cases
historical_diagnostic_use.purpose: problem definition and hypothesis generation only

options_considered.tradeoff: Highly interpretable but discards the strength of ordinary query-paper relevance.
Retains lexical relevance while exposing object modality task role and mismatch diagnostics.
Potentially more semantic but requires training data and risks memorizing the small W5 diagnostic set.
Flexible decomposition but adds model prompt cost and reproducibility governance.

selection_reason: This is the smallest label-free prototype that directly tests the W5 boundary-mismatch hypothesis while remaining deterministic auditable and W6-contract compatible.
limitations: Lexical matching is brittle to synonyms and implicit task descriptions.
Per-topic min-max normalization can be sensitive in very small candidate pools.
Fixture validation demonstrates contract compatibility rather than independent retrieval effectiveness.
